entry_points.text: Switch-to-guest dispatches by type running once per loaded state, capturing host GS and programming user-return registers; conventional path also captures selectors, bases and syncs nested controls when flagged.

Release dispatches by type; confidential refreshes posted then prepares host; posted put arms wakeup only for blocking non-preempted guests when allowed else suppresses; conventional releases posted before host restore.

Run dispatcher selects confidential versus conventional execution and init need; confidential entry declined during sept-zap wait with forced exits warning; entry uses normal notification vector including timer sampling.

Enter-exit wrapper applies mitigations with interrupts disabled, syncs debug address, invokes runner selecting launch versus resume, captures reason and vectoring, scrubs registers, restores speculation and reports failure with sentinel reason and zeroed vectoring.

Top dispatcher selects confidential versus standard handling; VMX promotes bus-lock; common applies flush, direct-leave, nested fatal, reflection, invalid diversion and failed conversion with bounds-checked dispatch; external accounts, window clears, timer notifies, immediate forwards.

exports.text: VCPU load dispatches by guest type to confidential or conventional loaders; conventional load narrows pause-loop window when descheduled with pausing inactive, then loads control and refreshes posted interrupts.

Privilege returns zero for virtual-8086 else derives level from saved stack rights with bypass; alignment delivery allowed without split-lock detection else only at user privilege with checking in controls and flags.

Interrupt queries cover both flavors: conventional blocked unless nested exits on interrupts else follows flags plus shadows; confidential allowed except halt with blocked indication, with deny-all build variant.

hazards.text: Entry uses layered defenses with conditional L1 flush consuming per-CPU flag via flush command or fill, framebuffer suppression caching value, plus scrubbing, buffer filling, speculation restore and branch clearing.

Guest operands allow port widths one, two and four, memory widths adding eight, direction zero read and one write, notification vectors thirty-two through two-five-five with validation and forwarding.

Private faults before acceptance with unexpected pending kill the machine; others force write with retry looping on signals, dead requests and invalid slots with yields; shared faults use reported qualification with fetch fatal.

Misconfiguration probes emulatability then fast shortcut with tracing else reserved-bit fault; enclave emulation queues invalid-opcode avoiding denial of service; emulation during vectoring rejected unless allowed; enclave mode requests fault propagation.

invariants.text: Secondary tuning needs host capability with guest selecting enable or exiting; dirty logging rejects confidential guests toggling by tracked slots; notify reflects flag; VPID prefers single, else global for nonzero, no-op for zero.

Load refreshes interrupts, returns early on same CPU or unassigned key else flushes and links; init needed unless ready; entry runs IRQs-off capturing reason with NMI handling and selective restore; unlisted map invalid; failed needs flag plus code.

Intercept inert without bitmaps honoring allow filter with recalc; write assumed when unused; entry flags encode launch, speculation and clearing; tracing inert in system mode; interrupt info cached; NMI needs valid plus type.

Records disabled for confidential guests; enable follows count with passthrough on active event; audit marks differing host indices; switching skips mediated counters; refresh no-ops when intercepted.

Host restore no-ops unless loaded else restores GS, segments and tables clearing marks; null segments give zero; NMI mask uses software flag or hardware bit; VMCS helpers do 32-bit RMW; qualification cached; immediate register decoded; empty flush inert.
Sync uses enlightened copy when valid else shadow then clears flag; shadow iterates tables restoring prior control; enlightened transfers segments and controls leaving host state untouched.

Host claims virtualization, non-maskable, denied AC, paging, debug, bus-lock, timers, faults, nested interrupts and disallowed CPUID; first level follows bitmap with always-exit classes and gated operations; helpers classify vectors and errors.

IO without bitmaps follows unconditional control else decodes port and width scanning tables; register moves compare masked values or consult controls; secure leaves need capability and map; structure access decodes field; trap follows monitor.

Exception resumes for NMI or machine-check else exits; CPUID uses R12/R13 writing R12-R15; hypercall bridges R10-R14; IO/MMIO validate width and direction with codes and completions; results use R10 code and R11 value.

Pre-dispatch resumes on non-idle hint, treats misconfig and errors as bugs, converts failed entry; calls support map, fatal, info, quote and notify; mapping checks opt-in and alignment emitting chunks; fatal leaves sixteen slots; info zero completes; quote needs shared buffer.

Entry synthesizes invalid failure when emulation required, keeps spaces coherent, clears shadow for single-step and coordinates pause, sync, debug, tracing, perf and timers; exit marks clean, restores state, accounts nested runs and completes perf, NMI and interrupts.

locks.text: Load removes from prior-CPU wakeup list under its lock with IRQs disabled updating control by retrying compare-exchange; blocking queues on current-CPU list with nesting, programs wakeup vector with self-signal on race; switching only where virtualization or bypass usable.

state_machines.text: Posted load skips when virtual APIC off or emulated elsewhere; else cleans wakeup, refreshes destination on migration with raw or shifted encoding, restores vector, clears suppress and promotes outstanding.
Trust-domain exits dispatch by class to emulated operations, faults and events, else unexpected; busy contention leaves fast path for outside requests; non-idle hints resume without work.

Tracing handoff inactive in system mode else preserves guest and reinstalls host including control; NMI recovery reasserts for guest faults except double-fault and vectoring; completion reestablishes NMI, exception or interrupt by type; interfaces carry valid, vector, type, error and unblock.

Fast path forces slow for nested except timer, routing writes, timer, halt and invalidate; timer absorbs spurious exits and expires LAPIC timer; hypervisor timer writes zero for forced else scaled delta or maximum; alternate build forbids use.

Nested reflection handles late failure first preferring host; invalid loops bounded servicing windows, events, emulation, halts and work; unhandleable when nested entry pending or exception outstanding outside virtual-8086.

structs.text: Invalidation operand pairs sixteen-bit identifier plus reserved space with guest address, issued with extent selecting single versus all contexts.

Tracing context holds control, status, output base and mask plus match and paired filters per range; descriptor keeps guest and host copies with count; hardware exposes control, status, base, mask, match and strided pairs.

Port checker consults maps treating out-of-range and unreadable as exit, using two eight-kilobyte ranges split at midpoint; register handling derives index selecting quadrants by kind and high base, testing bit.
